meta.title: Shuo Ba — Mandarin, zero to fluent
meta.principle: Stages are defined by what you can DO, not by how many words you have seen.

stages.title: Foundation
stages.goal: Survive a first encounter without freezing.
canDo: Say who you are and where you are from
Order food and ask a price
Tell time and arrange to meet

stages.title: Survival
stages.goal: Handle a day in a Chinese-speaking city alone.
canDo: Get around by taxi, metro and on foot
Shop, compare and complain about price
Order a full meal with preferences
Describe your family and where you live
Explain that something hurts or is broken

stages.title: Conversation
stages.goal: Hold a real conversation about your life, past and future.

stages.title: Fluency
stages.goal: Say what you actually mean, including things that are awkward.
canDo: Tell a story with sequence and detail

stages.title: Native-adjacent
stages.goal: Sound like a person, not a textbook.
canDo: Hedge and soften like a native
Use set phrases and chengyu naturally
Argue a position and concede a point
